Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
in Pearland, Texas. Can you state your full name for the record?
A: Yes, I'd rather keep my name off the recording, if that's all right. You can use the claim file for that.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe what you were doing when the collision happened?
A: I was driivng through an intersection and wanted to turn left. The light was green, but I was waiting for a gap in
oncoming traffic before I went.
Q: How did the other vehicle come into the picture?
A: A car coming the other way hit the front of my vehicle while I was turning. It came in pretty fast, from what I could
see.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did airbags deploy in your vehicle?
A: No, they didn't. The impact jolted me forward and then back against the seat.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They said I have whiplash. My neck is stiff and I get headaches when
I turn my head quickly.
Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care for those symptoms?
A: Yes, I have a follow-up scheduled, and I'm doing some physical therapy exercises at home.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?
A: Only that I've been careful to follow the treatment plan. I want the claim handled properly so I can get back to
normal.
Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
